fresh_package.note: Candidate was extracted fresh, verified against RELEASE_MANIFEST with no unlisted files, independently source-audited before executing package code, then passed 98/98 selftests plus CLI/GUI version and two-formation PROGRESSIVE UFO checks. Final package is rebuilt deterministically after recording this evidence.

limitations: Classic UFO formation is a project-owner human-facing label; transform/state evidence is executable-backed.
The later dynamic/randomized PROGRESSIVE UFO pose family is intentionally not frozen into a fake canonical preset.
Fresh retail Xbox game data was used only for external validation; no proprietary package, GMX, or generated retail glTF is bundled.
Native SIIG coordinate scale is preserved; no speculative meter conversion or hidden display scaling is applied.
Runtime acceptance of arbitrary fully original synthesized scenes remains a separate emulator/hardware gate.
Platform shader microcode compilation and remaining opaque GMX semantics remain unresolved.
Compressed/mipmapped native texture variants are not synthesized.
PS3 NPDRM/SDAT re-encryption is not implemented.
